block.name: Invoice record
block.purpose: An overdue invoice: status, reminder and download actions, line items with totals and a summary of what is owed.
block.description: The record template filled with invoice INV-0041 for Acme Corporation: an Overdue Badge, Void, Download PDF and Send reminder actions, section tabs, line items with quantities and end-aligned totals, and a summary of amount due, due date, customer and terms.
whenToUse: Starting point for an invoice, bill or payment detail page.
whenNotToUse: As a component: copy it and replace the data with your queries.
rules: Send reminder is the only primary Button; Void is ghost so it does not compete.
Each tab links to its own URL.
Totals are a definition list with numerals end-aligned.
